name: Reload Wi-Fi Radios
detail: Reloads both MediaTek MT7976 5GHz and 2.4GHz Wi-Fi radios.

name: Free RAM / Drop Caches
detail: Reclaims unused pagecache, dentries and inodes immediately.

name: Flush DNS Cache
detail: Flushes dnsmasq local DNS cache and restarts daemon.

name: Check 5G Modem Signal (CSQ)
detail: Queries Quectel RG500Q-EA signal quality and channel info.

name: Check CPU & SoC Temperature
detail: Reads MediaTek MT7986A Filogic SoC on-die thermal sensor.

name: Restart PassWall 2 Core
detail: Restarts PassWall 2 VLESS / Reality / Xray proxy acceleration.

name: Cycle All LED Show Modes
detail: Engages Arcadyan AW1000 all 6 front-panel LEDs kinetic animation.

name: Show Captive Portal Clients
detail: Displays authenticated vouchers and client MAC addresses.

name: System Resources & Load
detail: Displays system uptime, memory usage, and flash storage.
